summary: South Bow Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that all resolutions were approved at its annual general meeting of shareholders. The resolutions included the election of 11 directors with votes in favor ranging from 97.76% to 99.68%, the appointment of KPMG LLP as auditors with 99.84% approval, and an advisory vote on executive compensation with 96.96% approval. This is a routine meeting outcome disclosure, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or structural changes are present.
